name: Cricket scores
description: Live and recent cricket scores from ESPNcricinfo: each match's status, teams, scores and result, optionally only matches of one team or series.

team.description: only matches mentioning this team or series, e.g. India, Kerala, IPL (leave out for all)

notes: Checked on espncricinfo.com (Nov 2026; it may move to cricinfo.com): each match is a card whose link text reads 'RESULT 1st ODI … NZ 185 IND 143/5 India won by 5 wickets'.
